title: Malformed execution evidence must not take the Observer offline
summary: A truncated OpenCode tool call supplied a string where parser code expected an object, causing run-observer.py to fail and /bridge/observer to return 503. The parser now survives malformed tool input and Chrome renders observer snapshot failure as DEGRADED rather than companion OFFLINE.
claims: Observer parsing is fail-open at event granularity.
OFFLINE is reserved for transport/companion/auth failure; observer snapshot failure is DEGRADED.
Pairing remained valid during the incident.
decision: Treat execution logs as untrusted observer input and preserve the rest of the snapshot when one record is malformed.
rationale: Observability is most valuable when execution is failing; bad evidence cannot be allowed to disable the observer itself.
